theme_cn: 运动介词与指路（图5） + 校园地图阅读 + AI口语 + 键盘拼写
reading_name: 阅读理解 · 校园指路图
spell_name: 今天学的运动介词，敲一遍

speaking.sentence: How can I get to the library from the school gate?
options: Go along this road and turn left at the first crossing.
The gate is made of iron.
options_cn: 沿这条路走，在第一个路口左转。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: along /əˈlɒŋ/ 一个词，crossing /ˈkrɒsɪŋ/ 别丢词尾 ing
speaking.explanation_cn: 问路线要给出动作，A 用 Go along… and turn left 指路；B 说时间，C、D 没指路。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 Go along… / turn left / turn right 回答路线。

options: It is opposite the school gate, across from the park.
It is very big and clean.
I go there with my mum.
speaking.pronunciation_tips: opposite /ˈɒpəzɪt/ 重音在最前，across from 连读别吞掉 from
speaking.explanation_cn: A 用 opposite / across from 说清了位置；其余三项都不是地点。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 It is opposite / across from / next to… 说位置。

speaking.sentence: Which way do you run every morning?
speaking.sentence_cn: 你们每天早上往哪边跑？
options: We run past the library and then turn right.
We run because it is fun.
options_cn: 我们跑过图书馆，然后右转。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: past /pɑːst/ 与 passed 同音，then 的 th 要咬舌
speaking.explanation_cn: Which way 问方向，A 用 past 加 turn right 给出路线；B 说时间，C、D 没方向。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 We run past… / towards… / along… 说方向。

speaking.sentence: Where is the boy in the picture going?
speaking.sentence_cn: 图里的男孩要往哪儿去？
options: He is walking towards the gate.
speaking.pronunciation_tips: towards /təˈwɔːdz/ 重音在后，gate /ɡeɪt/ 词尾 t 要出声
speaking.explanation_cn: 问的是方向，A 用 towards the gate（朝大门）回答；其余三项没说去哪儿。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 He is walking towards / along / past… 说方向。

speaking.sentence: What is the ladder doing in the picture?
speaking.sentence_cn: 图里的梯子是什么状态？
options: It is standing against the wall.
speaking.pronunciation_tips: against /əˈɡenst/ 重音在后，wall /wɔːl/ 别读成 well
speaking.explanation_cn: A 用 against the wall 说清了「靠着墙」这个位置关系；其余三项都没回答位置。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 It is standing against / beside / under… 描述位置。

vocab.example_en: The bank is opposite the school gate.
vocab.hint_cn: 中间隔着一条路或一块空地，面对面

vocab.example_en: The ladder is against the wall.
vocab.hint_cn: 有接触，把重量压在那样东西上

vocab.example_en: Walk along this street and turn right.
vocab.example_cn: 顺着这条街往前走，然后右拐。
vocab.hint_cn: 顺着一条长线一直走，中途不拐弯

vocab.example_en: We run past the library every morning.
vocab.example_cn: 我们每天早上从图书馆门前跑过。
vocab.hint_cn: 从旁边走过去，脚步不停，也不进去

vocab.example_en: The boy is walking towards the gate.
vocab.example_cn: 男孩正朝大门那边走过去。

reading.passage: Our school has a big playground in the middle of the campus. The library stands on the left of the playground, and the science building is on the right. Walk along the green path past the library and you will find the small garden. The garden is not far from the gate, but the dining hall is far from it. Go straight ahead and turn right around the corner to see the art room. A sign above the door tells everyone where to go.
reading.passage_cn: 我们学校校园中央有一个大操场。图书馆在操场左边，科学楼在右边。沿着绿道往前走，经过图书馆，你就能看到那个小花园。花园离校门不远，食堂却离得很远。一直往前走，在拐角处右转就能看见美术教室。门上方的牌子会告诉大家该往哪儿走。

questions.question: Where is the library?
options: On the left of the playground
On the right of the playground
questions.explanation_cn: 第二句写 on the left of the playground（在操场左边）。

questions.question: What will you find if you walk past the library?
questions.explanation_cn: 第三句写 walk along the green path past the library and you will find the small garden。

questions.question: How can you see the art room?
options: Go straight ahead and turn right around the corner
questions.explanation_cn: 第五句写 Go straight ahead and turn right around the corner（直走、拐角右转）。

questions.question: What is above the door of the art room?
questions.explanation_cn: 末句写 A sign above the door（门上方有一块牌子）。

spell.question: 在对面：o_______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: opposite the school gate；也可说 across from。

spell.question: 靠着：a______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: The ladder is against the wall 梯子靠墙。

spell.question: 顺着走：a____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: walk along the street 沿着街走。

spell.question: 朝某方向：t______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: walk towards the gate 朝大门走。
